input: Enroll my kid in a weekend science camp

gold.taskTitle: Enroll My Kid in a Weekend Science Camp
gold.taskDescription: Find and enroll the user's child in a suitable weekend science camp.

questions.title: How old is your child right now?
questions.description: The child's age determines which age-group or grade-level camps are eligible.

questions.title: What city or area should the camp be in?
questions.description: Location narrows the search to camps that are geographically accessible.

questions.title: Which weekends or date range are you targeting?
questions.description: Knowing the preferred timeframe ensures the camp fits the family schedule.

questions.title: Is there a specific science topic your child is excited about?
questions.description: A preferred topic (robotics, chemistry, space, etc.) helps filter camps by theme.

questions.title: What is your budget per session or total?
questions.description: A budget range rules out camps that are too expensive or flags scholarship options.

questions.title: Should the camp be in-person, online, or either?
questions.description: The format preference determines whether local facility-based or virtual camps are considered.

questions.title: Have you already found any camps you are considering?
questions.description: Knowing if the user has existing options clarifies whether this is a search task or a registration task.
